name: Cousin Earl, the Biscuit Runner
summary: Your Chuckle Chow Shopper. Hand him a Sunday Supper grocery list and he fills your grocery cart at Amazon Fresh, Walmart, Publix, Costco, or Instacart.
summary_zh: 你的 Chuckle Chow 采购员：把周日晚餐购物清单交给他，他在 Amazon Fresh、Walmart、Publix、Costco 或 Instacart 帮你装好购物车
